sloka: आसनं पूजयामास रामायाभिप्रणम्य च ।वालव्यजनमादाय न्यषीदत् सचिवासने ॥ २.९१.३८॥
transliteration: āsanaṁ pūjayāmāsa rāmāyābhipraṇamya ca ।vālavyajanamādāya nyaṣīdat sacivāsane ॥ 2.91.38॥

translations.english: There where stood an exquisite throne, a fan and a parasol Bharata stayed in the company of ministers.
